summary: Implementation landed Phases 1-4 of the plan (all regeneration-independent source-store edits under agent-system/extensions/core/**, each verified by actually running the modified script and observing the result). Phase 1 replaced the `|| true` silent-fail idiom at all 10 events-append.sh call sites with a duplicated observable-but-non-fatal wrapper, catching and fixing a real set -e correctness bug along the way (a present-but-failing helper previously aborted the enclosing script before the wrapper could return 0). Phase 2 added a nullable `cwd` field ONLY to events-schema.json (not cc_session_id) and threaded --cwd through events-append.sh and both hooks; events-query.sh derives `repo` at query time as basename(cwd), never stored. Phase 3 extended check-extension-docs.sh with a new ADVISORY (not hard-FAIL) lane for core-extension never-deployed scripts/hooks and settings.json registration gaps -- deliberately ADVISORY rather than the plan's original FAIL design, per a binding orchestrator concurrency guardrail: a hard FAIL would have bricked the doc-lint gate for every caller (including a concurrently running sibling session validating an unrelated memory-extension manifest change) until the user's manual regeneration happens. An opt-in STRICT_CORE_DEPLOY=1 env var preserves the original hard-FAIL option. Phase 4 documented the no-headless-regeneration constraint in a new source-store pattern file and wrote a durable, user-executable HANDOFF.md. Phases 5-6 (manual <leader>al regeneration; doubly-gated event-flow verification) remain [BLOCKED] -- genuinely gated on human action and accumulated real usage, not fakeable. Task terminus is [PARTIAL] as designed; no phase claims event flow is verified today.

blocking_manual_steps: User must run <leader>al in nvim and choose 'Sync all (replace existing)' (NOT the default Cancel, NOT 'Add new only') at the vim.fn.confirm() dialog to deploy the finished source-store edits -- no headless/CI path exists.
User must repeat the same <leader>al 'Sync all' step in at least one other repo (e.g. ~/.dotfiles, confirmed to have the identical undeployed gap) for cross-repo verification.

User (or a separate ~/.dotfiles-repo task) must add cleanupPeriodDays: 365 (never 0) and CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TELEMETRY=1 + OTEL_METRICS_EXPORTER=console + OTEL_LOGS_EXPORTER=console to ~/.dotfiles/config/claude/settings.json, then run home-manager switch. This task does not edit that file.

End-to-end event-flow verification (specs/events.jsonl growing, check-extension-docs.sh green, a real lifecycle event fired) is doubly gated: first on the manual regeneration, then on accumulated real command usage over time. It cannot be observed today.
